601.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 6
601.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

601.clozeText: Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.
601.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

603.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 6
603.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

603.clozeText: Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.
603.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

604.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

604.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

605.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

605.clozeText: Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.
605.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐIỀN TỪ (CLOZE TEXT - PART 4):
Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

606.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

607.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

607.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

608.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 6
608.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. 608.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?

Minh:: How often do you watch it?

611.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

611.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

612.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.

Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

614.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 6
614.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?

=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

616.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

616.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

617.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. 618.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

618.clozeText: Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.
618.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐIỀN TỪ (CLOZE TEXT - PART 4):
Sports and outdoor games play an essential role in a healthy lifestyle. Playing sports regularly helps students develop strong bodies and (23) ________ stress after hard study hours. Football is the (24) ________ popular sport in the world, with millions of passionate fans. Besides football, swimming, badminton and running are also (25) ________ choices for teenagers. When you participate in team sports, you learn how to (26) ________ with your teammates. You should spend at least thirty minutes exercising (27) ________ day.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

618.sampleWritingText: My favourite TV programme is 'The World of Animals' broadcast on VTV7 every Sunday morning. It introduces diverse animal species living in tropical rainforests, polar regions, and deep oceans. The images are breathtaking with vivid natural sounds. Watching this documentary helps me broaden my knowledge about wildlife and raises my awareness of environmental protection.

Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.

Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

620.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 6
620.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: What TV programme do you like watching in the evening, Lan?
Lan:: I love watching animal documentaries on Discovery Channel.
Minh:: Why do you enjoy it?
Lan:: Because it shows amazing wildlife and teaches us how to protect nature.
Minh:: How often do you watch it?
Lan:: Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday evenings.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Pelé is considered by many people as the greatest football player of all time. He was born in Brazil in 1940. He began playing professional football at the age of fifteen. He won his first World Cup in 1958 when he was only seventeen years old. Throughout his brilliant career, he scored more than one thousand goals and won three World Cups with the Brazilian national team.

620.readingText: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan. It is one of the most modern, technologically advanced, and safest cities in the world. Tokyo has an incredible public transport system with ultra-fast bullet trains called Shinkansen. In Tokyo, visitors can explore ancient temples like Senso-ji alongside futuristic skyscrapers and neon-lit shopping districts. The street food in Tokyo is clean, fresh, and delicious, especially sushi and ramen. Although living costs are high, millions of international tourists visit Tokyo each year to experience its unique blend of heritage and technology.

701.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
701.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

During peak morning and evening hours, major avenues are choked with long queues of private motorbikes, personal cars, and buses (23) ________ at a snail's pace. The primary causes include rapid population influx, narrow roadway infrastructure, and non-compliance with basic traffic (24) ________. Additionally, commuters are strongly encouraged to utilize public transit systems, carpool, or cycle to reduce exhaust emissions and fuel (26) ________. 701.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

702.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

702.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

The film features breathtaking animation, touching acoustic music, and profound family values. It made me cry and appreciate my family even more. I highly recommend it.

703.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
703.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

703.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

704.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
704.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

704.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

705.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
705.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

705.clozeText: Traffic congestion represents a critical headache in many expanding metropolitan areas across Southeast Asia. During peak morning and evening hours, major avenues are choked with long queues of private motorbikes, personal cars, and buses (23) ________ at a snail's pace. The primary causes include rapid population influx, narrow roadway infrastructure, and non-compliance with basic traffic (24) ________. To alleviate traffic jams, municipal authorities are investing heavily in rapid bus transits and elevated metro (25) ________. Additionally, commuters are strongly encouraged to utilize public transit systems, carpool, or cycle to reduce exhaust emissions and fuel (26) ________. Collective civic responsibility and disciplined driving are paramount to building sustainable, (27) ________ urban transit.
705.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

706.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

The film features breathtaking animation, touching acoustic music, and profound family values. It made me cry and appreciate my family even more. I highly recommend it.

707.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
707.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

707.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

708.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
708.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

708.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

709.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
709.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

709.clozeText: Traffic congestion represents a critical headache in many expanding metropolitan areas across Southeast Asia. During peak morning and evening hours, major avenues are choked with long queues of private motorbikes, personal cars, and buses (23) ________ at a snail's pace. The primary causes include rapid population influx, narrow roadway infrastructure, and non-compliance with basic traffic (24) ________. To alleviate traffic jams, municipal authorities are investing heavily in rapid bus transits and elevated metro (25) ________. Additionally, commuters are strongly encouraged to utilize public transit systems, carpool, or cycle to reduce exhaust emissions and fuel (26) ________. Collective civic responsibility and disciplined driving are paramount to building sustainable, (27) ________ urban transit.
709.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

710.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

711.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

712.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
712.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

712.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

713.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
713.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

713.clozeText: Traffic congestion represents a critical headache in many expanding metropolitan areas across Southeast Asia. During peak morning and evening hours, major avenues are choked with long queues of private motorbikes, personal cars, and buses (23) ________ at a snail's pace. The primary causes include rapid population influx, narrow roadway infrastructure, and non-compliance with basic traffic (24) ________. To alleviate traffic jams, municipal authorities are investing heavily in rapid bus transits and elevated metro (25) ________. Additionally, commuters are strongly encouraged to utilize public transit systems, carpool, or cycle to reduce exhaust emissions and fuel (26) ________. Collective civic responsibility and disciplined driving are paramount to building sustainable, (27) ________ urban transit.
713.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

714.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

715.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

716.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
716.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

716.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

717.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
717.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

717.clozeText: Traffic congestion represents a critical headache in many expanding metropolitan areas across Southeast Asia. During peak morning and evening hours, major avenues are choked with long queues of private motorbikes, personal cars, and buses (23) ________ at a snail's pace. The primary causes include rapid population influx, narrow roadway infrastructure, and non-compliance with basic traffic (24) ________. To alleviate traffic jams, municipal authorities are investing heavily in rapid bus transits and elevated metro (25) ________. Additionally, commuters are strongly encouraged to utilize public transit systems, carpool, or cycle to reduce exhaust emissions and fuel (26) ________. Collective civic responsibility and disciplined driving are paramount to building sustainable, (27) ________ urban transit.
717.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

718.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

720.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 7
720.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Peter:: How do you commute to school every day, Lan?
Lan:: I usually ride my electric bicycle, but sometimes I walk because my house is nearby.
Peter:: How far is it from your home to school?
Lan:: It is about two kilometers. It takes roughly ten minutes.
Peter:: Do students always wear safety helmets when riding electric bikes?
Lan:: Yes, absolutely! It is a mandatory traffic safety regulation to protect our lives.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Every year on the full moon night of the eighth lunar month, Vietnamese children enthusiastically celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. Streets in major cities are adorned with colorful carp lanterns, vibrant star-shaped lanterns, and joyful lion dances. Families gather outdoors under the bright moonlight to feast on traditional mooncakes filled with lotus seeds and salted egg yolks. Children parade around their neighborhoods singing cheerful songs and participating in lantern contests.

720.readingText: The Cannes Film Festival, held annually in the glamorous resort town of Cannes on the French Riviera, is regarded as one of the most prestigious cinematographic gatherings globally. Established in 1946, the festival previews groundbreaking new feature films and artistic documentaries from around the globe. The highest distinction awarded at the festival is the celebrated Palme d'Or (Golden Palm), bestowed by an international jury of distinguished directors and actors. Beyond the high-profile red carpet galas, Cannes serves as a bustling international marketplace where film producers, distributors, and screenwriters negotiate distribution deals. The festival celebrates visionary storytelling and pushes the boundaries of cinematic art.

801.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
801.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

Developing comprehensive early warning radar networks and conducting community evacuation drills are vital for mitigating loss of (25) ________. When a disaster strikes, emergency services must mobilize swiftly to deliver medical supplies, potable water, and emergency (26) ________ to stranded populations. 801.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

801.sampleWritingText: To protect our local environment from severe plastic pollution, our school community has launched the 'Plastic-Free School' campaign. Firstly, students are strongly encouraged to bring personal stainless steel water bottles and reusable canvas tote bags rather than purchasing disposable plastic containers. Secondly, we organize weekly recycling drives to sort paper, metals, and plastic waste for industrial recycling. These concerted efforts have dramatically minimized littering in our schoolyard, fostered ecological stewardship among students, and inspired local households to embrace sustainable lifestyles.

802.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
802.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

802.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

803.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
803.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

803.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

804.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
804.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

804.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

805.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
805.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

805.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

Secondly, we organize weekly recycling drives to sort paper, metals, and plastic waste for industrial recycling. These concerted efforts have dramatically minimized littering in our schoolyard, fostered ecological stewardship among students, and inspired local households to embrace sustainable lifestyles.

806.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
806.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

806.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.

807.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỮA HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
807.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Khang:: Did you watch the evening news about the catastrophic typhoon hitting the central coastline, Mai?
Mai:: Yes, Khang. It was heartbreaking to see houses submerged and trees uprooted by hurricane-force winds.
Khang:: What was your family doing when the storm made landfall last night?
Mai:: While my father was securing the rooftop and window shutters, my mother was stockpiling food, drinking water, and first-aid kits.
Khang:: Is our school organizing any relief campaigns to support disaster victims?
Mai:: Yes! The Youth Union launched an emergency appeal for clothes, textbooks, and bottled water this morning.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Single-use plastics represent an alarming ecological catastrophe threatening terrestrial ecosystems and global oceans. Every minute, approximately one million disposable plastic shopping bags and beverage bottles are consumed worldwide, with less than ten percent recycled. The remainder accumulates in landfills or flows into rivers and seas, breaking down into microplastics that contaminate marine life and the human food chain. To combat this crisis, progressive communities are strictly prohibiting single-use plastic straws and encouraging biodegradable packaging made from cassava starch and bamboo fiber.

807.readingText: E-commerce and digital shopping platforms have revolutionized modern consumer behavior and retail industries worldwide. Armed with a smartphone or personal computer, consumers can effortlessly browse millions of products, compare prices across competitive vendors, and read authentic customer feedback before purchasing. Home delivery services transport parcels directly to customers' doorsteps within hours. However, the meteoric rise of online consumerism generates hidden ecological footprints. Excessive packaging materials, particularly non-recyclable bubble wraps and cardboard boxes, contribute significantly to urban municipal waste. Moreover, the reliance on high-emission courier transport intensifies traffic congestion and greenhouse emissions. To build sustainable e-commerce, leading retail giants are adopting biodegradable packaging and deploying electric delivery vehicles.
